h13.

**Impl: the unexported `*markdown.service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`, methods at lines 143-425) — the only implementation; construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`), called once in production at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`; holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`, `RSSService.MarkdownService`, and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService`.**

Details:

The interface is `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`), with eight methods (`ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`). Exactly one type satisfies it — the unexported `service` struct wrapping a `goldmark.Markdown` — so there's no runtime polymorphism and no mock implementation anywhere in the repo. I confirmed this by searching for other declarations of the distinctive methods (`RenameTag`, `ValidateContent`, `RenderHTML`); all hits are on `*service`.

Construction happens in exactly one production place: `NewAPIV1Service` builds it with the tag and mention extensions enabled and stores it on the API service (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-56`). `NewService` returns the interface type rather than the concrete struct, and it composes goldmark with GFM plus `extensions.TagExtension` and `extensions.MentionExtension` per the options. The only other construction site is the test helper at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`.

The three holders, and how the single instance propagates:

- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`) — used for mention extraction (`server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32`), webhook snippets (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:85`), and passed into payload rebuilds at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`.
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`) — not independently constructed; `server/server.go:85` hands it `apiV1Service.MarkdownService`, so RSS shares the same instance and uses it for `RenderHTML` at `server/router/rss/rss.go:339`.
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`) — declared and consumed at line 52, but that runner is never constructed in production; the package's live use is the package-level `RebuildMemoPayload`, which takes a `markdown.Service` parameter (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

So at runtime there is a single `*service` value, created inside `NewAPIV1Service` and shared by the API and RSS routers.
